portal_description:
OSTree is a tool for managing bootable, immutable, versioned file system trees.

The ostree packages have been upgraded to upstream version 2018.1, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version (BZ#1536611).

Users of ostree are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs and adds these enhancements.
